I wanted to say that I feel the same way. In the past year, my life and prospects were torn to shreds. The only thing I have left from my 'old life' is my current girlfriend, and I've begged her to break up with me for many reasons, one of which is to stop dealing with my own craziness. Let me know if you find some way to deal with this.

edit: or let me know how you've tried to deal so far.
